hostedFailure.case: ios-webkit: theme changes do not grow outstanding GPU resources
hostedFailure.diagnosis: The aggregate WebGL draw threshold included PMREM environment-generation work, allowing the resource baseline before the main scene and bloom pipeline allocated its targets.
hostedFailure.qualification: This trace does not independently prove leak-free operation; repeated checks now compare a fully initialized scene and each subsequent theme.

changes: Wait for two completed opt-in scene/bloom submission callbacks before the resource baseline.
After each confirmed DOM theme change, wait for two further scene submissions, then enforce the original baseline plus two texture and framebuffer bounds.
Use the same initialized-scene baseline and post-resize submissions in the retired-target check.
Retain existing 30-second startup and five-second per-change wait deadlines, zero retries, and resource limits.

localChecks.command: COMPATIBILITY_TEST_PORT=5215 npm run test:e2e:compatibility -- runtime-resilience.spec.js --grep 'theme changes do not grow|repeated canvas resizes' --repeat-each=3

limitations: Local mobile projects use browser emulation; physical iPhone confirmation of the shorter introduction remains pending.
